items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: All 5 ACs map to code: byte-identical package, fixture selection + checklist line in the report, 35 B items from brief Fit criteria plus shared items, state-reaching recipes with markers, small modules with unit tests.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: A check that throws becomes a failed item with the reason (recordProbe); a companion that cannot start fails its group with the first output lines; scenarios always stop the companion and delete temp folders.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: The built app is run with a clean env (no inherited keys), temp HOME, fixed argv, loopback only; tokens are random dummy values; no shell; file contents never enter the report except short evidence.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 17 new unit tests: fake servers over the real recorded files, approval stamp with the real pipeline digest, static checks on good and bad synthetic trees, a stub backend that passes and one that fails the Host rule, mockup selectors; 4 new pytest tests; existing 103 unit specs still pass.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Each scenario starts one process and waits for health; the only fixed sleeps are 1.1 s for run-id resolution and short UI settles.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: src/baseline/ holds 17 modules, largest 258 lines (cap 300); shared modules only got additive hooks.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: brief.json copy (hash-excluded keys only, verified with the pipeline digest), index.json replay, run-synthetic.json post, companion API, screen-map.json (python test pins one recipe per screen). No real built app exists to round-trip against; stub and real recordings used.
